title: Silver Springs: Clear Kayaking Wildlife Tour
includes: All kayaking equipment is provided. Life jackets, seats, paddles, and dry bags.
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: This is a great wildlife tour for families and travelers in our pristine clear kayaks. We might see manatees, monkeys, otters, and all other types of exciting wildlife underneath us! Your tour guide is very knowledgeable on the local wildlife, and will do their best at providing an exciting and memorable tour. Each tour focuses solely on wildlife and conservation of the Florida Springs.
